13 years ago, the Affordable Care Act was signed into law, extending health care coverage to millions of Americans.

As a doctor, I will continue to work to protect and strengthen this law and will fight any reckless attempts to strip away health care from Americans.

Wishing a happy National Doctor's Day to all our nation’s physicians! As an internal medicine doctor by training, I had the honor to care for patients alongside many talented and dedicated doctors.

Thank you for all you do to keep families safe and healthy. 🩺 https://t.co/Hu5wlEIJDC

As a physician, I believe personal health decisions should be made by patients and their doctors.

That's why I united my fellow physicians in Congress and OB-GYNs to denounce gov't intrusion in the exam room, which harms the patient-physician relationship and health outcomes. https://t.co/SLyPBZKgOy

Since the overturning of Roe, medical students have struggled to receive adequate training in reproductive care.

Today, I’m introducing a bill to expand access to training to ensure our future doctors can provide the best possible care to their patients.

https://t.co/jteQrycxJ1

As a doctor, I know that personal health decisions should be made between patients and their doctors, not extreme politicians.

That's why I will NEVER stop fighting for a woman's right to make her own health decisions, including access to full reproductive health care.

Are you a post-9/11 combat veteran who was discharged 10+ years ago?

If so, you may be eligible for free VA health care coverage made possible through the bipartisan PACT Act.

Open enrollment ends Sept. 30. See if you qualify and apply today: https://t.co/KYCmf4EeAw

Enrollment season through @CoveredCA is now OPEN! 

Learn more about how you and your family can access affordable health coverage by visiting https://t.co/YMbyolO8ry now! https://t.co/jYsGHsKPmG

As a physician who has cared for patients with diabetes, I understand the excessive cost of life-saving insulin for American families.

That's why I proudly supported the Inflation Reduction Act, voting to cap insulin costs at $35/month for our nation's seniors. #WorldDiabetesDay

BIG NEWS: A record 20M+ Americans have enrolled in health care coverage through the Affordable Care Act!

As a doctor, I know the importance of having access to quality & affordable health care. 

We must continue fighting to protect & strengthen the ACA. https://t.co/eRkDWsK1OP

NEWS: A record 21.2 million Americans have enrolled in health care coverage through the Affordable Care Act. 

We must strengthen and protect–– not weaken and repeal–– this vital program. 
https://t.co/UtHS4SMb8T

As a doctor and father, I am greatly concerned by this latest effort to criminalize reproductive health care. 

Women’s personal health care decisions should be made between her and her doctor, NOT by the government.   
https://t.co/oodI4oOoPH

As a doctor, I know just how important it is for my patients to have access to quality and affordable health care.

Thanks to President Biden’s leadership, a record 21.3 million Americans signed up for health insurance through the Affordable Care Act. #SOTU2024

I voted for President Biden’s Inflation Reduction Act to lower health insurance premiums, cap insulin costs for seniors, and provide free recommended vaccines for Medicare patients. 

Instead of repealing this legislation, let’s build on it.

#SOTU2024

A new report from @medicarepayment highlights the need to pass the Strengthening Medicare for Patients and Providers Act!

I am committed to ensuring America's doctors have a much-needed inflationary update to provide the best possible care for their patients.

From lowering costs to improving health outcomes and the efficiency of patient care, we will see AI rapidly transform the health care sector. 

As a physician serving on the Bipartisan Task Force on AI, I remain focused on ensuring that AI tools benefit our nation's patients. https://t.co/a72gl8JJhd

The CMS 2025 proposed rule is once again proposing reductions, reiterating the need to pass my Strengthening Medicare for Patients and Providers Act to provide doctors with a much-needed inflationary update to support their essential work.

I will continue to fight for our nation’s physicians to provide the best possible care for their patients.

On #WorldCancerDay, I stand with patients, families and survivors in the fight against cancer.  

As a doctor and Co-Chair of the Childhood Cancer Caucus, I'm committed to advocating for stronger investments in cancer research and better treatment options as we work toward ending cancer as we know it.

We know how many Medicaid patients live in every Republican district. 

If Trump, Elon Musk and Congressional Republicans cut Medicaid, we need to make sure their constituents know exactly who is responsible for taking their health care away. https://t.co/TKg2o4517X

The Republican budget plan cuts over $800 billion from Medicaid. 

I spoke with @FPWellman about how these cuts would take health care coverage away from millions of Americans. https://t.co/8IQij24qEL

Over 294,000 Medi-Cal recipients in #CA06 depend on this essential program for their health care, but the Republican budget plan puts their coverage at risk.
https://t.co/6VguWMRP8m

15 years ago today, President Obama signed the Affordable Care Act into law.

As a doctor, I've seen firsthand how the ACA has helped patients get the health care they need.

I'll continue to fight against Republican-led efforts to roll back the progress we've made and keep working to ensure every American has access to affordable, quality health care.

As doctors, we take an oath to put our patients first. 

When a woman comes to the ER, we don’t check her party affiliation. We provide the emergency care she needs to survive.

That’s our duty. That’s the law. And I’ll keep fighting to protect it. https://t.co/BKLW9Hz0MJ

Today’s Supreme Court ruling lets states cut off Medicaid patients from Planned Parenthood—even for cancer screenings and preventive care.

As a doctor, I know this puts women’s health at serious risk. It allows states to strip millions of women of access to the lifesaving care Planned Parenthood provides and denies them the right to choose their own doctor.

This is unacceptable. Health care decisions should be made by patients, not by politicians or judges.

Donald Trump's "Big Ugly Bill" will take health care away from millions of Americans.

As a doctor, I know just how devastating the ripple effects of this bill will be — from shuttered rural hospitals to seniors losing the nursing home care they rely on. https://t.co/5XyYmzOkQa

As a doctor, I’m proud of the progress we’ve made in California to expand health care and move closer to universal coverage.

Donald Trump’s “Big Ugly Bill” threatens to undo that progress by taking health care away from more than two million Californians. https://t.co/T9XTGdIls3
